predicates.P1: Selected v3 deciding clauses preserve v2 authority, material sufficiency, exact-basis and failure-conservation behavior for the compared discriminators.
predicates.P2: Selected foundation/library and concrete result-algebra consumers agree on predicate, performance, effects and conjunction without unsupported universal closure.
predicates.P3: The two neutral matched source-use tasks can be answered correctly from each method supported compressed entry under the same actor settings.
predicates.P4: Frozen qualification evidence establishes broad current-candidate superiority, installed-v3 use and categorical whole-path execution.
predicates.P5: This review can be reconstructed from frozen current workspace inputs and returns truthful closed predicate results within its declared limits.

evaluation_rule: Source comparison and bounded admissible observations decide each predicate; missing material coverage stays indeterminate. P4 is evaluated as an evidence sufficiency claim, not a request to execute qualification.
effects: assessment is effect-free; preparation/report and paid calls are separately bound Writer operations; no candidate mutation requested
